description: Type file importing from components/ — must block
content:
import { BookCard } from '../components/BookCard/BookCard';
export type Book = { id: string; title: string; };

description: Type file importing from hooks/ — must block
content:
import { useBooks } from '../hooks/useBooks';
export type Book = { id: string; title: string; };

description: Type file with no UI imports — allowed
content:
export type ReadingStatus = 'to-read' | 'reading' | 'done';
export type Book = { id: string; title: string; status: ReadingStatus; };

description: Type file importing from another type file — allowed
content:
import { Book } from './book';
export type Shelf = { books: Book[]; };

description: Type file with import from views/ — must block
content:
import { BookView } from '../views/BookView';
export type Book = { id: string; };

description: Type file with import from pages/ — must block
content:
import { HomePage } from '../pages/Home';
export type Book = { id: string; };

description: Component importing from types — allowed (correct direction)
content:
import { Book } from '../../types/book';
export function BookCard({ book }: { book: Book }) { return null; }

description: UI import in comment inside type file — strip:comments should ignore
content:
// see components/BookCard for usage
export type Book = { id: string; title: string; };
